hints.title: Range Coverage Interval
hints.text: A light at position p with range r illuminates all points x in [max(0, p - r), min(n - 1, p + r)].

hints.title: Difference Array Technique
hints.text: Apply +1 at start index and -1 at end + 1 index of a difference array of length n + 1.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Reconstruction
hints.text: Accumulate prefix sums to obtain the exact brightness at each coordinate from 0 to n - 1.

hints.title: Difference Array Implementation

complexity.notes: Difference array updates take O(L) followed by single O(n) prefix sum pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Incrementing each street position inside each light range takes O(n * L) and TLEs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Difference array requires O(n) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate immediately recognizes standard 1D range increment difference array.
